question: What goes wrong when my Stellar SDK or CLI is older than the protocol version the network runs, and how do I fix it?

golden.answer: Protocol upgrades can add XDR types, so an SDK built on older XDR can fail to decode new ledgers or transaction results, for example `Bad union switch` in the JavaScript SDK. Conversely, the host rejects a contract built for a newer protocol than the network runs. Fix: install the SDK and CLI releases published for that protocol. Testnet upgrades before Mainnet.
keyFacts: An SDK built on older XDR can fail to decode data from a newer protocol.
The fix is to upgrade to the SDK and CLI releases published for that protocol.
Testnet upgrades to a new protocol before Mainnet.
The host rejects a contract built for a newer protocol than the network runs.
golden.notes: Accept any concrete decode error text; the JavaScript example is not required. Accept the Software Versions page or the protocol upgrade guide as the place to find matching releases.

activation.author: gap lanes gap-1, gap-2, gap-3 (Claude Fable 5.2)

truth.notes: Observed 2026-11-14: Testnet and Futurenet report protocol 30, Mainnet reports 29; the Mainnet vote for Protocol 30 (Bell) is scheduled for 2026-11-23. The Bell guide says existing contracts keep working after that upgrade; this is stated per upgrade, so it is not a key fact. The host check is in rs-soroban-env parsed_module.rs ('contract protocol number is newer than host'). The other slot on this leaf (which releases match Mainnet's protocol) is not covered here. One parallel-cli research run (core-fast, 2026-11-14) agreed on all four facts.

corroboration.claim: An SDK built on older XDR definitions can fail to decode ledgers or transaction results from a newer protocol.

evidence.note: SDF states an older SDK may fail to decode Protocol 30 ledgers.
A real failure at the Protocol 23 Testnet rollout, confirmed by an SDK maintainer.
Independent run reached the same finding.

corroboration.claim: The fix is to upgrade to the SDK and CLI releases published for that protocol, listed on the Software Versions page and in each upgrade guide.

evidence.note: Upgrade to the latest version of the relevant Stellar SDK before each vote; lists the Protocol 30 releases.
Lists the release of each component per protocol and network.
The maintainer's fix was to move to the SDK release for the new protocol.

corroboration.claim: Testnet upgrades to a new protocol before Mainnet.

evidence.note: States the ordering and the gap of a few weeks.
Each protocol shows a Testnet date before its Mainnet date.

corroboration.claim: The Soroban host rejects a contract built for a newer protocol than the network runs.
